info.name: Flow 13 — Notification
info.description: Complete notification flow covering user notification preferences (get, update), paginated notification listing, unread count, mark-as-read (single and bulk), SignalR NotificationHub reference, notification source events (auction, order, item question / moderation), and error cases (404, 401).

request.description: Retrieve the current user's notification preferences. Returns default preferences (isEnabled: true, channels: '{}') if the user has not configured any yet. Requires permission: Catalogs.Me.ReadNotificationPreferences.

Update the current user's notification preferences. Enables both Email and SignalR channels. The 'channels' field is a JSON-serialized string array. QuietHours is optional and can specify time ranges when notifications are suppressed. Requires permission: Catalogs.Me.ManageNotificationPreferences.

Update preferences to keep only SignalR channel active (disable Email). This means the user will only receive real-time push notifications via the SignalR hub and will NOT receive email notifications.

Retrieve the current user's notifications with pagination. Returns a PagedList<NotificationDto> containing: id, notificationType, eventType, title, message, priority, status, entityType, entityId, metadata (JSON string), relatedEntities, actions, createdAt, readAt, expiresAt.

exec: console.log('No notifications found for current user.');

request.description:
--- Auction & Moderation Event → Notification Mapping ---

The following domain events automatically create notifications:

1. AuctionApprovedEvent → notificationType: 'moderation', eventType: 'item_approved'
   Recipient: Seller
   Priority: Normal
   Title: 'San pham da duoc phe duyet'

2. AuctionRejectedEvent → notificationType: 'moderation', eventType: 'item_rejected'
   Recipient: Seller
   Priority: High
   Title: 'San pham can chinh sua'
   Includes rejection reason and count in metadata.

All auction notifications include metadata with auctionId, itemId, and reviewerId.
Notifications are routed through NotificationRoutingService which respects the user's channel preferences (Email, SignalR).

This is a documentation-only request.

request.description:
--- Order Event → Notification Mapping ---

The following domain events automatically create notifications:

1. OrderCancelledEvent → notificationType: 'order', eventType: 'order_cancelled'
   Recipient: Buyer
   Priority: High
   Title: 'Don hang da bi huy'
   Metadata: orderId, orderNumber, reason

2. OutboundShipmentPickedUpEvent → notificationType: 'order', eventType: 'order_shipped'
   Recipient: Buyer
   Priority: Normal
   Title: 'Don hang da duoc giao don vi van chuyen'
   Metadata: orderId, orderNumber, outboundShipmentId, trackingNumber, providerCode

3. OutboundShipmentDeliveredEvent → notificationType: 'order', eventType: 'order_delivered'
   Recipient: Buyer
   Priority: Normal
   Title: 'Don hang da duoc giao thanh cong'
   Metadata: orderId, orderNumber, outboundShipmentId, providerCode, deliveredAt

4. OutboundShipmentDeliveredEvent (if DecisionWindowEndsAt is set) → eventType: 'decision_window_started'
   Recipient: Buyer
   Priority: Normal
   Title: 'Thoi gian quyet dinh da bat dau'
   Metadata: orderId, orderNumber, decisionWindowEndsAt

This is a documentation-only request.

request.description:
--- Item Question Event → Notification Mapping ---

The following domain events automatically create notifications:

1. ItemQuestionAskedEvent → notificationType: 'item_question', eventType: 'item_question_asked'
   Recipient: Seller (item owner)
   Priority: Normal
   Title: 'Co cau hoi moi cho san pham {itemTitle}'
   Message: 'Mot nguoi dung vua gui cau hoi cho san pham cua ban.'
   Metadata: itemId, questionId, askerId, questionPreview (max 120 chars)

2. ItemQuestionAnsweredEvent → notificationType: 'item_question', eventType: 'item_question_answered'
   Recipient: Question asker
   Priority: Normal
   Title: 'Cau hoi cua ban da duoc tra loi cho san pham {itemTitle}'
   Message: 'Nguoi ban da tra loi cau hoi cua ban.'
   Metadata: itemId, questionId, askerId

Available notification channels (from NotificationChannel enum):
- InApp ('In App')
- Email ('Email')
- SignalR ('SignalR')

Notification priority levels: Normal, High.

This is a documentation-only request.
